name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.MaskedEval.mask_leak
title: Canonical-deviation attack: with a BGG+ constrained PRF, a statement-independent masked evaluator leaks every mask
statement: In the setting of subtract_identity let D(z) = O(z) - EvalCt(f_z, c). If z0, z1 belong to the same statement and f_{z1}(x) - f_{z0}(x) = 1 (e.g. a witness and a non-witness of a trivially true statement), then for every point zs: D(zs) - f_{zs}(x) (D(z1) - D(z0)) = P(stmt zs) + noise, where the noise is an explicit short combination of the evaluator and encoding errors. So anyone holding the constrained key and the evaluator computes the mask P of every statement, true or false, unless the CPRF's deviation is not a fixed vector (as in BV15's G^{-1}(D_x) construction).
